title: Profile or QR invitation with a coupon

source.title: Welcome new customers from a QR code
source.original_goal: Welcome new customers from a QR code
source.demand_evidence: Catalogue presence only; popularity and conversion are unmeasured.

native.messages_text: Placement: "Open this Instagram profile and DM {keyword}." DM: "Your code is {coupon_code}. {coupon_terms}"
native.end_stop: Inbound word receives the exact code; S.
native.difference: Native entry is the DM word, not a QR scan. Verify profile_url belongs to the connected account. Use an existing QR or the host's available QR/file tool with a proven encoder; decode it to that exact URL before delivering a printable file. Do not generate QR modules as an illustration. Without a verified image tool, deliver the profile invitation and state that a printable QR is not supplied. No scan attribution or redemption claim.

use_when: A profile invitation or existing QR directs people to ordinary DMs for a coupon.
prerequisites: Have the correct connected profile URL, coupon code and terms. A printable QR requires a proven encoder and exact decode verification.
exclude_when: Do not choose for scan attribution, verified redemption or an unverified illustrated QR. Without a verified tool, no printable QR is supplied.
Do not configure when required lifecycle operations are unavailable on the actual host.

steps.action: Actual new inbound campaign word in an ordinary Instagram DM. Placement is a coach action, not a trigger.
Send the exact approved first message. Deliver any promised value now.
Stated outcome only. No inferred booking, registration, purchase, verified follow or verified share.
End this campaign on refusal. Do not restart from a keyword in the refusal.
Send nothing for silence or external clicks; enforce current delivery windows.
Same-run repeat does not restart intake, resend a bonus or duplicate capture. Ambiguous late replies need clarification.
Use native team handoff on person request, unresolved facts or approved handoff criteria. Text alone is not handoff proof.
